name: GOV Notify Integration
description: Integration with GOV.UK Notify and similar services.
project_description:
This module enables you to send emails and SMS messages from Drupal using the the UK or Canadian Government's Notify service. You can send regular and system messages and use any Notify templates that you have setup.

 The UK and Canadian Government's Notify services are highly-available, scalable, notifications platform for use by Government departments and agencies. 

 
 https://digital.canada.ca/2019/11/26/introducing-notify 
 https://www.notifications.service.gov.uk 
 
 Installation documentation is available at https://www.drupal.org/docs/8/modules/govuk-notify/installation
